verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of an org-level control over an agent tool is the 'Enable desktop mode' toggle for Computer Use, plus CLI sandbox deny rules that can optionally restrict network traffic. Neither amounts to a general allowlist for external tools and integrations. Missing for 10: an admin control to enable or disable specific integrations (Slack, Jira/Linear, MCP servers), per-tool permission or allowlist settings, role-based governance of integration access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access

citations.quote: Computer Use is controlled by the Enable desktop mode toggle in your organization's customization options.
enforcing writable paths and deny rules at the operating-system level and optionally restricting network traffic
